section.title: zFCP (Fibre Channel Protocol) Storage
section.para: Agama supports the activation of zFCP disks during unattended installations. This allows you to use Fibre Channel storage on IBM Z (Mainframe) systems as installation targets.

section.title: How Activation Works
section.para: There are two ways to handle zFCP storage in your configuration:

listitem.para: Controller Activation (LUN Scan): If your storage server supports LUN Masking (automatic discovery), you only need to activate the controller. Agama will then automatically perform a LUN Scan to find and activate all disks assigned to that channel.
Manual Disk Activation: If automatic discovery is not supported, you can manually define each disk using its unique hardware coordinates.

section.title: Configuration Reference
section.para: The zFCP settings are located in the zfcp section of your JSON configuration.

section.title: 1. Activating Controllers (zfcp.controllers)
section.para: To activate a controller and trigger an automatic search for disks, add its channel ID to this list.

listitem.para: Behavior: Activating a controller here will attempt to find all associated storage volumes automatically.

section.title: 2. Activating Specific Disks (zfcp.devices)
section.para: Use this section to explicitly define disks. This is required if the controller cannot discover LUNs automatically. Each device requires three identifiers:

listitem.para: channel: The ID of the zFCP controller (e.g., "0.0.fa00").
wwpn: The World Wide Port Name of the storage server port (e.g., "0x500507630300c562").
lun: The Logical Unit Number of the specific disk volume (e.g., "0x4010403300000000").

note.para: If you define a disk in devices but forget to list its controller in controllers, Agama will automatically activate the controller for you.

listitem.para: Activate two controllers for automatic scanning (fa00 and fc00).
Manually activate two specific disks on fa00.
Explicitly disable a disk on fb00.
